guard: a successor reaps a crashed manager's custodied seat process, verified by start identity, before it retires the lifecycle and frees the alias
why: The suite runs a real manager on the custodial pty runtime, kills it with SIGKILL, proves the custodian and seat child survive, then boots the same logical successor and watches its startup terminal.

The mutation removes the reap step from the terminal's cleanup. Without it the successor verify-evicts the broker rails and retires the lifecycle while the seat process keeps running outside every manager, which is the leak this suite exists to end.

mutations.name: retire the lifecycle without reaping the orphan process
mutations.expectRed: successor reaps the orphan seat process before retiring the lifecycle
mutations.cell: successor reaps the orphan seat process before retiring the lifecycle
